macros.name: Block
macros.doc: The macro \Block can be used to typeset an block.

macros.name: defineLimapLanguage
macros.doc: Provide the definitions for a language.

macros.name: MapBlockLabelFont
macros.doc: The macro \MapBlockLabelFont determines the font changing command to be used for typesetting the block label.

macros.name: MapBlockTOC
macros.doc: The macro \MapBlockTOC is a macro which adds one line to the table of contents.

macros.name: MapContinued
macros.doc: The macro \MapContinued contains the text appearing at the end of map which are continued on the next page.

macros.name: MapContinuedFormat
macros.doc: This macro determines the format of the bottom line on continued maps.

macros.name: MapContinuing
macros.doc: The macro \MapContinuing contains the text appearing at the beginning of map which are continued from the previous page.

macros.name: MapFont
macros.doc: The macro \MapFont determines the font changing command to be used when starting a new map.

macros.name: MapNewpage
macros.doc: The macro \MapNewpage is expanded whenever a new page is required between maps.

macros.name: MapParskip
macros.doc: The macro \MapParskip determines the vertical distance of the text from the separating rules.

macros.name: MapRuleStart
macros.doc: The macro \MapRuleStart is inserted before rules around blocks.

macros.name: MapRuleWidth
macros.doc: The macro \MapRuleWidth determines the width of the rules drawn between blocks.

macros.name: MapTableOfContents
macros.doc: The macro \MapTableOfContents can be used to typeset the table of contents for a map.

macros.name: MapTableOfContentsStyle
macros.doc: The macro MapTableOfContentsStyle determines the style of the TOCs.

macros.name: MapTabularFraction
macros.doc: The macro \MapTabularFraction contains a factor for the line width occupied by the tabular.

macros.name: MapTextFraction
macros.doc: This macro determines the part of the page width devoted to the text area.

macros.name: MapTitleContinuedFont
macros.doc: This macro determines the font changing command to be used for typesetting the additional text after titles on followup pages of multi-page maps.

macros.name: MapTitleFont
macros.doc: The macro \MapTitleFont determines the font changing command to be used when typesetting the title of a map.

macros.name: MapTitleFraction
macros.doc: The macro \MapTitleFraction determines the part of the page width devoted to the block label area.

macros.name: MapTOC
macros.doc: The macro \MapTOC is expanded to generate the entry in the table of contents.

macros.name: MapTOCname
macros.doc: The macro \MapTOCname contains the text of the heading in table of contents of maps for the column of map titles.

macros.name: MapTOCpage
macros.doc: The macro \MapTOCpage contains the text of the heading in table of contents of maps for the column of page numbers.

macros.name: WideBlock
macros.doc: The macro \WideBlock can be used to typeset a piece of information on the whole page width.

envs.name: Map
envs.doc: The environment Map can be used to typeset a map.

envs.name: MapTabular
envs.doc: The environment MapTabular provides a convenient way to include a table into a block.
